head: 94c013506f5d782870868bfb0d65ff43ba74ca95
summary: sandbox.failIfUnavailable is false, so on any runner where the OS-level sandbox cannot be initialized the session silently runs unsandboxed instead of stopping, dropping the sandbox's network allow-list (github.com, pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org) that is supposed to bound every outbound call a session's allowed Bash commands (e.g. `git push`, `pip install`) can make.
